# specdecode
> Packed-bitset logit masking (C ABI, WASM, Python ctypes), a whole-word type-state token pruner, KV block bookkeeping and a draft/frontier router with a CUSUM e-detector, in Zig 0.16. Prototype; not integrated into any inference engine.

- `specdecode_mask_logits_f32(logits, n, mask_words, n_words)`: set disallowed logits to -inf in place; ~12 us for 128,256 logits on M2 Max, ~14x faster than NumPy.
- `SemanticPruner`: whole-word tokens of one call form `name(arg, arg)`; ~0.45 ms per step on a 32k vocabulary. Not BPE-aware.
- `KvPagePool`: metadata-only dedup/pin/evict model; holds no tensors.
- `CascadeRouter`: escalation on pruner rejection, low confidence, or a CUSUM e-detector (mean steps between false drift escalations >= 1000 at the expected failure rate).

README.md is the source of truth, including measured numbers with hardware and commit.
